title: Install recommended macOS software updates
summary: Download and install only the updates that Apple recommends for your Mac. This skips optional or non-critical updates.

steps.explain: Run the software update tool with the install and recommended flags to apply only the updates Apple suggests.

alternatives.explain: Use short flags for the same result.

rollback.explain: There is no simple command to undo a software update. You may need to restore from a Time Machine backup if an update causes issues.

warnings: Installing updates can take a long time and may require a restart.
Ensure you have a backup before installing updates.
